mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_LeastPrivilege removes the role/operation gate. The injected witness is a successful GetAudit call by a customer-role caller, which is explicitly denied by the permission matrix; LeastPrivilege should detect this.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Success and op.caller.role = CustomerRole and op.kind = GetAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditFromOp lets an AuditEntry exist without any creating Operation — i.e., an entry that was 'forged' or rewritten with no provenance, which is exactly the append-only violation we want to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | no op: Operation | op.createdEvent = ae }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_StateChangingProducesAudit lets a successful submission complete without writing an audit entry. The injected witness forces exactly that, so AuditCompleteness must report a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = SubmitApp and op.outcome = Success and no op.createdEvent }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CustomerOwnership permits a customer to successfully GET an application owned by a different customer; the ownership-based-access invariant should detect this leak.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipViolation { some op: Operation, other: User | op.caller.role = CustomerRole and op.outcome = Success and op.kind = GetApp and some op.target and other.role = CustomerRole and op.target.customer = other and op.caller != other }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_DecideRequiresAssigned removes the only fact that binds the deciding officer to the assigned officer at the operation layer. Injecting a successful DecideApp whose caller is not the target's assigned officer must produce a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AssignedDecidesViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = DecideApp and op.outcome = Success and some op.target and some op.target.assignedOfficer and op.target.assignedOfficer != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OneInFlightPerCustomer removes the partial-unique-index analogue. Injecting two distinct in-flight applications for the same customer must be detected by FR_008_OneInFlight.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InFlightViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.customer = a2.customer and a1.status in (Submitted + UnderReview) and a2.status in (Submitted + UnderReview) }
